description: List DDS participants observed on the bus as a `ParticipantListing`: `guid`, `vendor` (read from the GUID prefix, `unknown` for vendors that do not put theirs there, e.g. Dust DDS and RTI Connext; see `vendor_source`), optional `name` (the announced EntityName, e.g. `lidar_driver`; a participant with none is normal, not a fault: identify it by its topics), `hostname`, `domain_id` and `is_observer` (TopicForge's own read-only participant, listed like any other). Lifecycle: `status` (`active` / `left`), `first_seen_ns` / `last_seen_ns` (TopicForge's clock), `announced_ns` (DDS source timestamp) and, once left, `lost_ns` + `lost_time_source`: an upper bound of the death (exact after a clean shutdown; after a crash the lease expiry, so up to one lease earlier: 10 s Cyclone, 20 s Fast DDS, 100 s RTI). **Restarts**: a restarted node is a new GUID with the same name; `restarts_by_name` gives `lives` (GUIDs) and `departures` per name, so do not count GUIDs by hand (`seen_count` is not a restart count). Cyclone tracks discovery in the background; right after start the call waits up to 3 s for it. **Only the domain joined at startup is observed** (`health_check` `dds_domain_id`): a participant on another domain is INVISIBLE here, and `domain_id` does not switch domains (restart with `TOPICFORGE_DDS_DOMAIN_ID`). Works at the raw DDS layer, so non-ROS participants appear too. **Read-only by architecture**: it cannot publish, modify QoS or alter the bus. **Raises an MCP error** when no DDS module is active (install `topicforge[dds]`, set `TOPICFORGE_DDS_BACKEND=cyclone`); the mock backend returns fixtures. **Duration**: uses the DDS binding behind the DDS lock (one call at a time); the whole call, lock wait included, ends within 45 s, and if another DDS call holds the lock it fails at once with a `busy` error (retry).

domain_id.description: Ignored: it does not switch domains and is only range-checked (0..232). The domain observed is the one joined at startup (`TOPICFORGE_DDS_DOMAIN_ID`), reported in the response `domain_id`; `note` flags a different non-zero value.

name: list_participants

departures.description: Times a participant with this name was lost.

lives.description: Distinct GUIDs that carried this name; restarts = `lives` - 1.

announced_ns.description: Source timestamp of the latest announcement, on the announcer's clock; `None` if unavailable.

first_seen_ns.description: Wall-clock ns of the first discovery sample seen; `None` without lifecycle tracking.

is_observer.description: True for TopicForge's own read-only observer participant.

last_seen_ns.description: Wall-clock ns of the latest discovery sample; `None` without lifecycle tracking.

lost_ns.description: Once `left`: ns upper bound of the death (exact after a clean shutdown; after a crash the lease expiry, up to one lease earlier: 10 s Cyclone, 20 s Fast, 100 s RTI). `None` while active.

name.description: Announced EntityName (e.g. `lidar_driver`); `None` when the application set none (Dust DDS cannot).

node_names.description: Fully qualified ROS 2 node names sharing this participant; empty when `node_names_source` is `none`.

seen_count.description: Discovery observations of this GUID in this server's lifetime. Not a restart count: a restart is a new GUID (see `restarts_by_name`).

status.description: `active`, `left` (seen earlier, since gone) or `unknown` (no lifecycle tracking).

vendor.description: DDS implementation read from the GUID vendor prefix: cyclone, fast, rti, rti_micro, opensplice, opendds, coredx, intercom, dust, mock or `unknown` (Dust DDS and RTI Connext do not put theirs there); see `vendor_source`.

vendor_source.description: `guid_prefix` when `vendor` was read from the GUID, else `none`.

restarts_by_name.description: Names seen with several GUIDs or lost at least once (absent: ran once and stayed). A restart is a new GUID with the same name.

restarts_note.description: Set when unnamed participants were left out of `restarts_by_name`.

title: List DDS participants
